n: 4.7-4.8 Cu. Ft. Top Load Washer with 2 in 1 Removable Agitator
desc: Customize your loads the way you want in this 4.7-4.8 cu. ft. Whirlpool® Top Load Washer with 2 in 1 Removable Agitator. Simply remove the agitator to give bulky items a little more space to move.
hl: The industry-first 2 in 1 Removable Agitator lets you customize any load to care for your clothes the way you want by easily swapping the agitator post in or out.
Easily prewash clothes and other items right in the washer with a conveniently located faucet that gives you easy access to an instant water stream to remove loose soils.
Save a step by soaking and washing in one cycle.
Easily remove the industry-first 2 in 1 Removable Agitator when your load needs a little more space to move.
Get more water to help break down loose soils.
Smooth Spiral Stainless Steel Wash Basket
Help protect fabrics with this stainless steel wash basket that gently guides clothes during the wash.
